context.description: The run supervisor starts work from the machine's tags and records every outcome as a fact

evidence.trustReason: Fresh-context review of verify-spec-SV2.spec.ts (committed, sha256 prefix 8ea8b61091ab24df); my own bun run at HEAD f57285510d: 5 pass, 0 fail, 63 expect(). Everything under test is real: the RunSupervisor machine spawned by a real TaskHarness root as run:<id>, the real task and scenario supervisors and workers, a real Recorder over the real event store, a scratch git repository; only the model side is scripted, and the Recorder's record is wrapped only to list what it receives. Given a run with a ready leaf and a verifying scenario: asserted from the fold of the stored slice - T1.3 (no children) is the only task tagged ready/active, S2 the only scenario tagged verifying. When the run supervisor reads the run actor: its watch actor relays the real run actor's snapshots. Then it spawns one task supervisor for the leaf and one scenario supervisor for the scenario: the run supervisor's children equal exactly task:<id>:T1.3 and scenario:<id>:S2; every other task and scenario has no system entry; further snapshots (T1.3 building) spawn no second one. And each supervisor records its phase outcome as a fact through the Recorder: the store equals the wrapper's list exactly, in order - run.resumed, task.started T1.3 (worktree exists and the view holds its session), scenario.verified S2 trusted (the judge verdict came through the real hook routing), task.needs_human T1.3 with reason 'spend cap: ...'; and the run actor's log moved T1.3 building, S2 trusted, T1.3 needs_human in the same order. And a supervisor stops when its unit leaves ready/active/verifying: S2's supervisor stops when S2 is trusted while T1.3's supervisor and the run go on; T1.3's supervisor is the same ref across ready->building, then stops at needs_human (its builder turn is cancelled) while S2's supervisor and the run go on. And the run machine invokes nothing: a state-node walk of machine(plan) (over 100 nodes) finds no invoke, with a control that the same walk finds the run supervisor's invokes; implementations.actors is empty; and in a live run the run actor's snapshot holds no child. The eventually helper fails after 20 s, so no wait is blind. No gap found.
